question: Happy New Year! In arc five, it looks like he had a falling-out (?) with Old Man Will; up to the start of arc six, when he met with Old Man Wil while Subaru was around, was he hiding his ill will? If he called him by his name in front of Subaru, instead of calling him "Honored Grandfather", I get the feeling they'd be found out...
answer: I don't know if you'd call it hiding his ill will; both of them were avoiding contact, so there wasn't any timing where Subaru could notice. At that time, there weren't even many chances to give Julius' problem and such higher priority.
